_comment: production-shaped CHAINED MAXIMUM aggregate for Issue #1738. Two RELU leaves (neuron-l1, neuron-l2) feed an inner MAXIMUM (neuron-m1); the inner MAXIMUM and a third RELU leaf (neuron-l3) feed an outer MAXIMUM (neuron-m2) that drives the identity output. Used to characterise contribution propagation through *chained* selection squashes: impact flows as a product of per-hop win fractions. On the committed window (see tests/issue_1738_aggregation_squash_impact_characterisation.rs) neuron-l1 deterministically wins the inner MAXIMUM (so the product-of-marginals equals the true joint), and the inner MAXIMUM wins the outer MAXIMUM on half the observations. Conservation must hold at every hop. Fixtures only - no engine behaviour change. Input neurons are implicit (referenced as input-N).
